title: A Pina program and its SDK release in lockstep with on-chain deploy eligibility

setupFiles..changeset/upgrade-vault.md:
---
"transfer": program_breaking
---

Require a nonzero `value` on the initialize
instruction so empty initializations can never reach the on-chain program.

setupCommands: git init -b main -q && git add -A && git commit -S -qm "chore: initialize transfer workspace" && git tag v1.2.0
expectation: A Solana program release with today's primitives: the Pina program crate and its npm SDK share group `main`, so one breaking program change plans 2.0.0 for both under a single v2.0.0 tag. The program is not registry-published (publish disabled), so package publications name only the SDK. The `onchain` stream routes the change to the upgrade-notes output, which is what marks the release as owing an on-chain program deployment; the user-stream SDK notes are not owed. The declared artifact digest resolves from the SBF stub, and preparing the release stamps the program crate, the npm SDK, the checked-in Codama IDL (program.version), and the deploy manifest to 2.0.0 while rendering the upgrade note.

checks.why: A cross-ecosystem cargo+npm config with custom streams, format versioned files, a declared hash value, and a disabled publish must load and resolve its targets.

checks.command: monochange preview --format json > .preview.json && node -e "const a=require('node:assert/strict'),fs=require('node:fs'),c=require('node:crypto');const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.preview.json','utf8'));const t=d.release_targets[0];a.equal(t.id,'main');a.equal(t.version,'2.0.0');a.equal(t.tag_name,'v2.0.0');a.deepEqual([...t.members].sort(),['transfer','transfer-sdk']);a.deepEqual(d.package_publications.map(p=>p.package),['transfer-sdk']);const digest=c.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync('target/deploy/transfer.so')).digest('hex').slice(0,16);a.equal(d.values['transfer.artifact_digest'],digest);const outs=d.changelogs.map(x=>x.output+':'+x.stream);a.ok(outs.includes('upgrade_notes:onchain'),'upgrade note missing from plan');a.ok(!outs.includes('sdk_notes:user'),'sdk note must not be owed');console.log('lockstep plan ok');"; rc=$?; rm -f .preview.json; exit $rc
checks.why: The release plan must answer the three questions a Solana release has: what version (2.0.0 lockstep across both packages under one tag), what ships where (only the SDK is registry-published), and whether an on-chain upgrade is owed (the onchain-stream output exists because a program change landed). The digest of the exact ELF must resolve into the plan's values.

checks.command: monochange prepare >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -F 'version = "2.0.0"' programs/transfer/Cargo.toml && grep -F '"version": "2.0.0"' apps/sdk/package.json && grep -F '"version": "2.0.0"' idl/transfer.json && grep -F '"version": "2.0.0"' deploy/mainnet.json && grep -F 'nonzero' deploy/upgrade-notes/2.0.0.md && test ! -e apps/sdk/release-notes/2.0.0.md
checks.why: Preparing the release must move every artifact that carries the version — the program crate, the SDK manifest, the checked-in Codama IDL (its program.version; the top-level Codama standard version must be untouched), and the deploy manifest — and render the upgrade note for the on-chain change. A user-stream note must not appear because no user-stream changeset exists; an SDK-only release owes no on-chain deployment and this release owes no SDK note.
